title: Add an Organize fields by name transformation

whenTrue.content:
# Add an Organize fields by name transformation

{{< docs/video id="g1DXq_IuJ7I" align="right" start="450" end="506" >}}

The organize fields by name transformation allows you to rename, reorder, or hide fields returned by a single query in your panel. This transformation is applicable only to panels with a single query.

{{< /docs/video >}}

To use the organize fields by name transformation, complete the following steps:

1. Open your dashboard in edit mode.
1. Click **Transformations** tab and click **+ Add transformation** button.
1. Select or search for **Organize fields by name**.
1. Use the following table as a guideline for all the actions available.

    | Actions                                        | When to use                                                     |
    | -----------------------------------------------| ----------------------------------------------------------------|
    | Change field order    | When you want to change the field order, either manually or automatically.               |
    | Hide or show a field  | When you want to hide fields that are not relevant.                                      |
    | Rename fields         | When you want to customize the field names.                                              |

1. The transformation should be applied automatically. If not, click **Refresh** to verify the visualization looks as intended.

    The following image shows a table with some fields re-ordered manually, `Miles_per_Gallon` field renamed, and fields such as `Year` and `Origin` hidden.

    ![Automobiles table with Organize fields by name transformation applied](/media/docs/learning-journey/data-transformations/automobiles-after-transformation.png)

1. Save your dashboard.
